name: start
comment: Show the title picture with four lines of text and ask for G (game) or I (instructions).

name: show_instructions
comment: Full-screen text: six pages of instructions ending with the cast of characters

name: run_adventure
comment: Print CTRL-D BRUN ADVENTURE: DOS takes it as a command and loads the game over this program
column6: so the RTS is only reached if the BRUN fails.

name: rt_copy
comment: ---- the macro library (see src/adventure.s and NOTES.md) ---- copy X bytes: .word src

name: BUMP16
comment: word at .word dst += word at .word src

name: rt_compare
comment: compare X bytes at (WORK) with .word addr; cmp_result = 0 if equal

name: rt_return
comment: return to the caller's caller skipping X inline operand bytes
